identity.tuple_encoding: each UTF-8 component is prefixed by an unsigned 64-bit big-endian byte length
identity.vertex_id: lowercase hex of the first 16 bytes of SHA-256(tuple)
identity.edge_id: lowercase hex of all 32 bytes of SHA-256(tuple)
identity.nebula_rank: positive signed 63-bit value from the first 8 big-endian bytes of edge_id; zero maps to one

projection_hash.serialization: UTF-8 JSON of the exact ordered structures implemented by EntityProjectionSHA256 and RelationProjectionSHA256; attribute keys and evidence identities are sorted

provenance.rule: derived and analyst relations can never be serialized as observed facts

ordering.admission: same projection identity and aggregate version with another hash is permanent conflict; lower versions are permanent late events
ordering.application: only the lowest non-applied offset in each Kafka partition can be claimed
ordering.commit: Nebula acknowledgement precedes PostgreSQL current-state and watermark commit
ordering.ambiguity: a crash after Nebula acknowledgement replays the same deterministic mutation

failure_policy.invalid_or_conflicting_source: canonical DLQ broker acknowledgement is required before source offset commit
failure_policy.target_failure: bounded retry then PostgreSQL DEAD record; later events in the partition remain blocked
failure_policy.repair: no automatic deletion; replay requires explicit authorization
